categories.main_business_segments: Verisign operates a single reportable segment focused on domain name registry services and internet infrastructure. The company is the exclusive registry operator for the .com, .net, and .name generic top-level domains (gTLDs), as well as certain internationalized domain names (IDN gTLDs) and country code TLDs (ccTLDs) such as .cc. It also provides Root Zone Maintainer services and operates two of the 13 global internet root servers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Verisign's core technologies include its proprietary Shared Registration System for domain name management and the ATLAS distributed lookup system, which processes hundreds of billions of DNS queries daily. The company operates a global constellation of secure, distributed DNS servers and data centers, employing advanced networking, security, and data integrity protocols. Continuous internal and third-party security testing, redundancy, and disaster recovery are integral to its operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Verisign's primary customers are ICANN-accredited registrars, who in turn serve individual and organizational registrants seeking domain names. The end markets include businesses, entrepreneurs, and individuals establishing online identities, with a significant portion of demand driven by e-commerce, online advertising, and internet usage growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: Verisign serves customers globally, with significant revenues from the U.S., EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), China, and other regions including Canada, Japan, and Singapore. The majority of its workforce and operations are based in the U.S., but it maintains a global presence through distributed infrastructure and international registrar relationships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Verisign operates as a critical infrastructure provider at the core of the internet's domain name system (DNS) supply chain. It functions as the authoritative registry operator (upstream) for several major TLDs, providing foundational services that enable registrars (midstream) to offer domain registrations to end users (downstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Verisign's strategic focus is on maintaining and enhancing the security, stability, and resiliency of its internet infrastructure services. R&D initiatives target new and enhanced registry services, DNS monitoring and visualization, data services, and security features. The company actively invests in internal development and innovation, while also considering technology acquisitions and collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Verisign generates revenue primarily through fixed fees charged to registrars for the initial registration and renewal of domain names in the .com, .net, and other TLDs it operates. Revenue is recognized ratably over the registration term, and pricing for .com and .net is regulated by agreements with ICANN and the U.S. Department of Commerce. Additional revenue comes from operating other TLD registries and providing technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Verisign faces competition from other gTLD and ccTLD registries such as CNNIC, DENIC, Nominet, Identity Digital, Public Interest Registry, CentralNic, Google, .xyz, GoDaddy, and Radix. It also competes indirectly with search engines, social media, and e-commerce platforms that offer alternative means of online presence. Verisign holds a dominant position as the exclusive operator of the .com and .net TLDs, which are among the most recognized and widely used globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Verisign reported revenues of $1.42 billion, a 7% increase over the prior year, and operating income of $943 million. The company managed 173.8 million .com and .net domain registrations at year-end, with a renewal rate of 73.7%. Verisign has a history of strong cash flow generation, significant share repurchases, and maintains a robust balance sheet with $980 million in cash and marketable securities as of year-end 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Verisign emphasizes the security, stability, and resiliency of its DNS infrastructure as its core value proposition, supporting the majority of global e-commerce and enabling reliable internet navigation. Its exclusive operation of the .com and .net registries, global infrastructure, and proven track record of uptime and security differentiate it from competitors. The company’s brand strength and regulatory compliance further reinforce its trusted position in the internet ecosystem.
